identification: Strapped pack (3 steel straps with top battens, on bearers) of new, unfinished Tasmanian oak tongue-and-groove flooring, catalogued 65 x 20 mm; end view about 8 boards wide by about 18-20 layers, relief-grooved undersides. Batten marked 'APPROX 13.0 m/2 TAS OAK T+G FLOORING' with a yellow circled pack number (looks like 5). Looks like a sister pack of lot 1970 from the same seller.

viewing_check: Measure board cover width and thickness; count layers x boards across and estimate average length to check the m2 claim; pull a few boards from the middle to see the share of short (<60 cm) offcuts; check for end-matching, splits, borer, moisture staining and mixed species; note how you'd move it (ute/trailer, roughly 250-400 kg).
